points.title: Legal full-word Get handshake
points.condition: A handshake with opcode Get (4), size 2, mask 1111, word-aligned address, no integrity flip.

points.title: Legal PutFullData handshake
points.condition: A handshake with opcode PutFullData (0), size 2, mask 1111, word-aligned address, no integrity flip.

points.title: Legal PutPartialData handshake
points.condition: A handshake with opcode PutPartialData (1), size 2, mask 1111, word-aligned address, no integrity flip.

points.title: Read response without error
points.condition: A D handshake with d_opcode AccessAckData and d_error 0.

points.title: Write response without error
points.condition: A D handshake with d_opcode AccessAck and d_error 0.

points.title: Error response to a read
points.condition: A D handshake with d_opcode AccessAckData and d_error 1.

points.title: Error response to a write
points.condition: A D handshake with d_opcode AccessAck and d_error 1.

points.title: A-channel back-pressure
points.condition: i_a_valid is 1 while o_a_ready is 0.

points.title: A-channel back-pressure for 3 or more cycles
points.condition: i_a_valid is 1 and o_a_ready is 0 for the third or later consecutive cycle.

points.title: D-channel back-pressure
points.condition: o_d_valid is 1 while i_d_ready is 0.

points.title: D-channel back-pressure for 3 or more cycles
points.condition: o_d_valid is 1 and i_d_ready is 0 for the third or later consecutive cycle.

points.title: Back-to-back A handshakes
points.condition: A handshakes in two consecutive cycles.

points.title: Two or more outstanding requests
points.condition: Number of accepted requests not yet answered is at least 2.

points.title: Unmapped offset below 0x400
points.condition: A handshake to a word offset in a gap 0x48..0xFF, 0x180..0x1FF or 0x300..0x3FF.

points.title: Misaligned address
points.condition: A handshake with address[1:0] not 0 below 0x400, no integrity flip.

points.title: Oversize request
points.condition: A handshake with a_size 3, no integrity flip.

points.title: Undefined opcode
points.condition: A handshake with opcode other than 0, 1 and 4, no integrity flip.

points.title: Mask covering inactive lanes
points.condition: A handshake with size 2 and mask not 1111, or size 0 and mask 1111, no integrity flip.

points.title: Byte write to PER_PIN_OE/INTR_CTRL range
points.condition: A write handshake, size 0, to an address in 0x200..0x2FF, no integrity flip.

points.title: Byte write to wide register
points.condition: A write handshake, size 0, to a core register offset below 0x48 or to the PER_PIN_IO range, no integrity flip.

points.title: Byte read (sub-word, size 0)
points.condition: A read handshake with size 0, no integrity flip.

points.title: Half-word read (sub-word, size 1)
points.condition: A read handshake with size 1, no integrity flip.

points.title: Instruction-fetch read
points.condition: A read handshake with i_a_instr 1.

points.title: Request with corrupted integrity accepted
points.condition: An A handshake with i_a_intg_flip 1.

points.title: Alert pulse observed
points.condition: o_alert is 1.

points.title: Repeated alert after integrity fault
points.condition: o_alert is 1 after an integrity-fault request and at least one earlier alert pulse since it.

points.title: ALERT_TEST fatal_fault write
points.condition: A full-word write handshake to 0xC with data bit 0 and bit 31 both 1.

points.title: ALERT_TEST regwen clear write
points.condition: A full-word write handshake to 0xC with data bit 31 equal 0.

points.title: DATA_OUT direct and masked writes
points.condition: A full-word write handshake to 0x14, 0x18 or 0x1C.

points.title: DATA_OE direct and masked writes
points.condition: A full-word write handshake to 0x20, 0x24 or 0x28.

points.title: PER_PIN_IO write on GPIO 0/15/16/31
points.condition: A full-word write handshake to PER_PIN_IO of GPIO 0, 15, 16 or 31.

points.title: PER_PIN_OE write on GPIO 0/15/16/31
points.condition: A write handshake to PER_PIN_OE (0x200+8*i, 0x204 slot excluded) of GPIO 0, 15, 16 or 31.

points.title: PER_PIN_INTR_CTRL write on GPIO 0/15/16/31
points.condition: A write handshake to PER_PIN_INTR_CTRL (0x204+8*i) of GPIO 0, 15, 16 or 31.

points.title: Interrupt control and filter register write
points.condition: A full-word write handshake to 0x2C..0x3C (rising, falling, level high, level low, input filter).

points.title: INTR_STATE/INTR_ENABLE/INTR_TEST write
points.condition: A full-word write handshake to 0x0, 0x4 or 0x8.

points.title: Interrupt output change
points.condition: o_intr_gpio differs from its value in the previous cycle (rise or clear).

points.title: Reset released after activity pending
points.condition: First cycle after reset release where a request was outstanding or a response was valid at the last cycle before reset.

points.title: Short reset of at most 2 cycles
points.condition: First cycle after reset release following a reset that lasted 1 or 2 cycles.

points.title: i_strap_en rising edge
points.condition: i_strap_en is 1 and was 0 in the previous cycle.

points.title: Strap valid output high
points.condition: o_straps_valid is 1.
